title: Playboy June 1982 Shannon Tweed Playmate of the Year Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Vintage 1982 issue with the original gatefold cover. Light toning and faint wear on the cream front cover, small wear at the lower spine edge; back cover clean. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, June 1982 - Playmate of the Year issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold and the original gatefold cover.

Cover: Shannon Tweed, Playmate of the Year, on a gatefold cover that opens out, with her pictorial inside.

Back cover: Crown Royal ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
